name: Claimpaign
description_short: QR-based airdrop tool for in-person campaigns.
description_long: Cardano airdrop tool for real-world token distribution at conferences, meetups, and hackathons. Organizers create claim campaigns for ada, fungible tokens, or NFTs and hand out printed QR codes; recipients scan and claim to their own wallet instead of receiving unsolicited wallet pushes. Supports unique or shared codes, per-wallet limits via stake key deduplication, real-time claim tracking, and refunds of unclaimed codes as credits when a campaign ends. Runs on preprod and mainnet, and is a reference implementation of CIP-99 (Proof of Onboarding).
